analysis.headline: Sells Your Data (Indirectly)
analysis.quote: Although we have not “sold” or “shared” personal data for money in the past 12 months, we engage in routine practices with our Digital Properties involving third parties that could be considered a “sale” or “sharing” as defined under California law.

analysis.headline: Shares with Marketing Partners
analysis.quote: Categories of Third Parties to Whom Personal Data is “Sold or Shared”: Companies that operate Cookies and Tracking Technologies, described in Section 5, such as marketing and advertising partners. Business partners who we partner with to jointly market or sell our products and Services, such as channel partners.

analysis.headline: Tracks You Across Sites
analysis.quote: Some tracking technologies enable us to track your device activity over time and across devices and websites.

analysis.headline: Ignores Your Do Not Track
analysis.quote: While some browsers have incorporated Do Not Track or DNT preferences, we do not honor such signals from web browsers at this time.

analysis.headline: Collects Your Sensitive Data
analysis.quote: Sensitive Personal Data, such as proof of vaccination or race and ethnicity (optional) (where permissible under applicable law).

analysis.headline: Retains Your Data Post-Termination
analysis.quote: Once you and/or your company have terminated the contractual relationship with us or otherwise ended your relationship with us, we may retain your personal data in our systems and records to ensure adequate fulfillment of surviving provisions in terminated contracts or for other legitimate business purposes, such as to evidence our business practices and contractual obligations, to provide you with information about our products and services, or to comply with applicable legal, tax, or accounting requirements.

analysis.headline: Transfers Your Data Internationally
analysis.quote: Due to the global nature of our operations, some of the recipients mentioned in Section 2 of the Notice may be located in countries outside the EEA, Switzerland, or the U.K., which do not provide an adequate level of data protection as defined by data protection laws in the EEA, Switzerland, and the U.K.

analysis.headline: Not Responsible for Subscribers
analysis.quote: We are not responsible for the privacy or data security practices of our Subscribers.

analysis.headline: Offers Data for Incentives
analysis.quote: We may offer a benefit or offering in exchange for you providing personal data, such as a discount or coupon to individuals who respond to a survey.
